# Realm Identifier

## Contract
A realm's identity is its URL with a trailing slash — the prefix of every
card, module, and file it holds. `RealmField` carries realm references with
realm-aware display (name, icon).

Invariants:
- Always trailing-slash terminated
  (`https://realms-staging.stack.cards/richard.tan1/boxel-software-matrix-layer/`).
- Permissions (read/write/realm-owner) attach at this granularity; a JWT is
  scoped to one realm identifier.
- Card URLs are realm identifier + realm-relative path.

## Captured example
This realm's identifier is the URL prefix shared by every id in it.
